# Frozen real-identifier sample for the v1.0.62 over-mask count.
# These 3000 camelCase names, length 16 to 24, are Release QA's rq74b real.txt
# corpus. They are not type declarations and they were not
# taken from node_modules. scripts/print-corpus-keep-rate.mjs prints
# `frozen-masked N of 3000` for this file. The harness is a truncated
# PEM: two body lines, a blank gap, the name, then `~ ctx`.
# 773 of 3000 is what v1.0.61 masks on this corpus. This cut's count is
# the `frozen-masked` line. Do not add names from this file to the hump
# list. The separate `real-masked` line still walks node_modules and
# depends on the lockfile.
